data.name: Lucidum Life
data.detailed_description:
About:

Lucidum Life is a game based on dreams and nightmares, where you and the main character, Flockos Crawldear, are aware of each one's existence and must work together to join all the pieces of the powerful artifact named Lucidum Life.

Gameplay features:

  • Explore big, liminal, and strangely nostalgic environments, slashing enemies and destroying evil auras while saving people from their corrupted dreams.

  • Create and manipulate objects with your cursor and create your own dynamic combos.

  • Characters have feelings, and you can manipulate them if you have enough LUCIDITY.

  • Gain LUCIDITY by collecting magical butterflies and turning them into magical strings to weave into your dreamcatchers.

  • Build your own pattern of attacks and combos in the menu.

data.short_description: Lucidum Life is a mix of linear and metroidvania platform game with a cartoonist pixel art style where you control a kitty named Flockos Crawldear. Create and dominate your own powerful skills building your own pattern of attacks and combos.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: 8, 8.1, 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400
  • Memory: 700 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel(C) Core(TM) i5-6500T
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 2048SP
  • DirectX: Version 12

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains some moments of dramatic and detailed blood. Sometimes, the blood may appear in different colors for fictional characters, but it remains very realistic and violent.

Some quotes describing brutal acts are mentioned throughout the game and may be disturbing to some players.
